text:
danielle: AE check-in  OrcaBio wants to run a 3-week POC with their finetuned model `orca-13b-ft-v3`. They need Private deploy (VPC), customer-managed KMS, embeddings + chat, and a strict P95 latency target of <150ms for short queries. Can we confirm catalog onboarding path + any blockers?

harry: Quick q  is the artifact gguf, HF, or a container? Any custom tokenizer or LoRA adapter?

danielle: They uploaded `orca-13b-v3.gguf` + `tokenizer.json` and a small LoRA adapter `orca_adapter.pt`. Tokenizer is BPE with a custom BOS/EOS. They've also included a prompt set for regression testing.

mike: Runtime note: gguf + LoRA adapter is OK but we need to verify adapter format (is it standard LoRA keys?). If adapter cannot be applied at serving time we'll need to merge into a fused artifact. Also custom BOS/EOS requires token compatibility check — mismatch can break prompt framing.

sophie: Security flags: customer requests per-request audit logs (including inputs) retained for 90 days and EU data residency. We default to metadata-only logs; raw input retention needs legal sign-off and explicit SOW language. Also require a KMS ARN.

ingest-bot: [artifact-scan] orca-13b-v3.gguf scanned  tokenizer.json found (vocab 46k), adapter file detected (PyTorch state_dict). Special tokens: custom <|bos_orca|> and <|eos_orca|> present. No license blockers detected.

harry: Perf: 13B at P95<150ms at peak 30 rps is aggressive. Options: (1) Dedicated warm pool pinned to model replicas + KV cache, (2) quantized int8 on T4/A10g GPUs with more replicas, (3) hybrid: embeddings on a smaller 7B embed model. If they want strict P95 we should recommend Dedicated with 2-3 warm replicas.

danielle: They also asked for deterministic outputs for evals. We'll run with temperature=0 and disable top_p.

mike: If we do LoRA merge server-side, estimate ~2-4 hours of ops work for a single merge + verification. Also need memory footprint: request whether int8 is acceptable; if yes we can reduce GPU requirements.

sophie: For KMS: customer must provide Key ARN with policy granting RedwoodDeployRole kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey OR opt into a customer-managed deploy agent. For raw input logs we need a signed data-handling annex in the SOW. Also EU-only deploy requires region lock and audit retention in-region.

harry: On the catalog side, we'll run tokenizer compatibility and a small regression eval against their prompts. If the adapter is fine, we can accept `orca-13b-ft-v3` as a trial catalog entry scoped to the POC (private only). We'll also prepare a fallback policy to `orca-7b-embed` for embeddings and `orca-7b-distill` for gen fallback. Call out semantic drift.

adan: (typo fix) -> danielle: noted :)

mike: Minimal suggested deploy config to share with customer:
```
model: orca-13b-ft-v3
format: gguf
adapter: orca_adapter.pt (merged at deploy time)
precision: int8
deploy_mode: private
region: eu-west-1
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 5
batching: { max_tokens: 1024, dynamic_window_ms: 8 }
audit_mode: metadata-only (raw-inputs requires SOW)
fallback_policy: route_to_orca_7b_on_capacity
```

harry: Tokenizer quick check (run locally):```bash
python -c "from tokenizers import Tokenizer; t=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json'); print(len(t.get_vocab()))"
```

ingest-bot: [ticket-scan] prompt-set attached (120 prompts)  suggests running 50 random evals for regression before handing to customer.

danielle: Action items: Harry -> tokenizer + adapter compatibility / small regression eval. Mike -> ops sizing + cost delta int8 vs fp16 + time estimate to merge adapter. Sophie -> security checklist & required SOW language for raw input retention and KMS snippet. I'll draft the POC SOW and include fallback/QA caveats.

harry: Running token check & adapter load now; will post mismatch or merge failure quickly.

mike: I'll size infra and provide a ballpark POC quote (int8 vs fp16) in 12h. If they insist on P95<150ms we should recommend 3 warm replicas.

sophie: I'll draft the security redlines and KMS policy snippet and attach to Jira.

deploy-bot: [ticket] Created: #SW-4999 "OrcaBio POC - orca-13b-ft-v3 onboarding" assigned to harry,mike,sophie. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/SW-4999

danielle: Thanks team  will update AE and ask customer for KMS ARN and confirm raw-input retention consent. Ping this thread for any blockers. :eyes:
